```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(LEA)
library(tess3r)
library(vcfR)
library(maps)
library(canadianmaps)
```

```{r}
mylfmm <- vcf2lfmm('final.recode.vcf')
mylfmm <- read.lfmm('final.recode.lfmm')
mylfmm <- replace (mylfmm, mylfmm == 9, "NA")
```

```{r}
coords <- read.csv('final_popmap.csv', header = T)
coords1 <- coords[,2:3]
coords1 <- as.matrix(coords1)
```

```{r}
tess3.obj <- tess3(X = mylfmm, coord = coords1, K = 1:10, 
                   method = "projected.ls", ploidy = 2, openMP.core.num = 4, rep = 10, keep = "Best") 
```
```{r}
plot(tess3.obj, pch = 19, col = "blue",
     xlab = "Number of ancestral populations",
     ylab = "Cross-validation score")
```



```{r}
q.matrix <- qmatrix(tess3.obj, K = 2)
barplot(q.matrix, border = NA, space = 0, 
        xlab = "Individuals", ylab = "Ancestry proportions", 
        main = "Ancestry matrix") -> bp
axis(1, at = 1:nrow(q.matrix), labels = bp$order, las = 3, cex.axis = .4) 
plot(q.matrix, coords1, method = "map.max", interpol = FieldsKrigModel(10),  
     main = "Ancestry coefficients",
     xlab = "Longitude", ylab = "Latitude")
```
```{r}
q.matrix2 <- qmatrix(tess3.obj, K = 3)
barplot(q.matrix2, border = NA, space = 0, 
        xlab = "Individuals", ylab = "Ancestry proportions", 
        main = "Ancestry matrix") -> bp
axis(1, at = 1:nrow(q.matrix), labels = bp$order, las = 3, cex.axis = .4) 
plot(q.matrix2, coords1, method = "map.max", interpol = FieldsKrigModel(10),  
     main = "Ancestry coefficients",
     xlab = "Longitude", ylab = "Latitude")
```

```{r}
q.matrix <- qmatrix(tess3.obj, K = 4)
barplot(q.matrix, border = NA, space = 0, 
        xlab = "Individuals", ylab = "Ancestry proportions", 
        main = "Ancestry matrix") -> bp
axis(1, at = 1:nrow(q.matrix), labels = bp$order, las = 3, cex.axis = .4) 
plot(q.matrix, coords1, method = "map.max", interpol = FieldsKrigModel(10),  
     main = "Ancestry coefficients",
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
map.polygon <- canadianmaps::PROV[PROV$region %in% "Eastern",]

palette1 <- c("#9F2519FF", "#351821FF")
palette2 <- c("#9F2519FF","#F65620FF", "#351821FF")
```


```{r}
mypalette <- CreatePalette(color.vector = palette2, palette.length = 15)
```

```{r}
q.matrix2 <- qmatrix(tess3.obj, K=2)
q.matrix3 <- qmatrix(tess3.obj, K=3)
pl <- ggtess3Q(q.matrix3, coords1, map.polygon = map.polygon, col.palette = mypalette)
pl
```

```{r}
pl+ geom_sf(data = map.polygon, color = "black", fill = "transparent")+ylim(43, 48)+geom_point(data = coords1, aes (x = lon, y = lat), shape = 21, colour = "black", fill = "white", size = 2)+ theme_map()

ggsave("tess.k3.pdf")
```

```{r}
pl2 <- ggtess3Q(q.matrix2, coords1, map.polygon = map.polygon, col.palette = mypalette)
pl2
pl2+ geom_sf(data = map.polygon, color = "black", fill = "transparent")+ylim(43, 48)+geom_point(data = coords1,aes (x = lon, y = lat), shape = 21, colour = "black", fill = "white", size = 2)+ theme_map()
ggsave("tess.k2.pdf")
```
